# UFT Engineering

> Marking-out and measuring tools for model engineers and home workshops. A small mail-order tool shop in Sheffield, South Yorkshire, England. Hand tools only; UK delivery only.

## Price list (GBP)
- Engineer's square set (50/75/100 mm): £34
- Scriber and centre punch set: £18
- Granite surface plate, 300 × 200 mm: £79
- Pair of ground parallels: £29
- Toolmaker's clamps, pair: £24
- Starter marking-out kit: £139

## Not offered
No machining to order, no drawings or calculations for clients, no power tools, no shipping outside the UK.
